app.name: Patient Records
app.description: Medical records for a plastic surgery practice

home.title: Welcome, {name}
home.subtitle: You are logged in with password and 2FA.

errors.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.inactive: This account is suspended. Contact the administrator.

twoFactor.title: Verification code
twoFactor.intro: Open the authenticator app on your phone and enter the 6-digit code.
twoFactor.recoveryHint: Lost your phone? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.
twoFactor.trust: Trust this device for {days} days (no verification code)
twoFactor.trustWarning: Only on your own device, never on a shared computer.
twoFactor.recoveryUsed: You used a recovery code. {left, plural, =0 {You have none left — ask the administrator for new codes.} one {# code left.} other {# codes left.}}

errors.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.expired: The login expired. Please start again.

setup2fa.title: Set up two-step verification
setup2fa.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone (e.g. Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator).
setup2fa.step2: In the app, add an account and scan this QR code:
setup2fa.manual: Can't scan? Type this key instead:
setup2fa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app:
setup2fa.codesIntro: If you lose your phone, each code logs you in once. Save them now (print or password manager). They will not be shown again.
setup2fa.alreadyShown: The codes are shown only once and have already been shown.

invitation.subject: Invitation to Patient Records
invitation.body: {inviter} created an account for you in the practice's Patient Records. Use the link to choose a password and set up two-step verification:
invitation.expires: The link works once and expires in {hours} hours.
invitation.network: It only opens through the practice's private network (Tailscale).
invitation.ignore: If you did not expect this message, ignore it.

invite.title: Set up your account
invite.intro: Choose a password for {email}. Next you will set up two-step verification.
invite.generated: Your password — save it now (e.g. in a password manager):
invite.invalid: The link was already used or has expired. Ask the administrator to send a new one.

errors.too_short: The password must have at least {min} characters.
errors.invalid_link: The link is no longer valid.

form.name: Full name
form.method: How will the person get in?
form.methodPassword: Generate a password now (you hand it over)

levelHelp.OWNER: Everything. Can never be removed in the app.
levelHelp.ADMIN: Everything a User can, plus users, devices, settings.
levelHelp.USER: Day-to-day work with full patient access.
levelHelp.GUEST: Read-only, no contact details. Needs an end date.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.self: You cannot do this to yourself.
errors.email_taken: A user with this email already exists.
errors.guest_needs_end_date: A guest needs an end date in the future.
errors.not_invited: The user already has a password.

created.mailFailed: The user was created but the email was NOT sent. Try “Re-send invitation”.
created.password: The user's password — shown only now. Hand it over in person:

detail.resent: Invitation sent again. The old link no longer works.
detail.generateConfirm: The current password stops working and the user is logged out. Continue?
detail.reset2faConfirm: Removes their 2FA, trusted devices and logins. They set it up again at next login. Continue?
detail.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this user? This cannot be undone. Their activity history stays under “Deleted users”. To pause access, use “Suspend”.
detail.ownerProtected: Owners cannot be deleted, deactivated or demoted in the app.
detail.readOnlyOwner: Only an Owner can change an Owner's details.
detail.suspendConfirm: Suspend this account? The user is logged out at once and cannot log in. Everything is kept and you can reactivate them.

deleted.title: Deleted users
deleted.intro: These accounts were permanently deleted. Their activity history stays in the audit log.
deleted.name: Name

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every login and change, in Greek time. Entries cannot be changed or deleted.

backups.title: Backups
backups.intro: Every night at 02:30 the database is copied, checked with a test restore and encrypted. 14 daily, 8 weekly and 12 monthly copies are kept.
backups.stale: No successful backup in the last {hours} hours.
backups.never: No backup has been made yet.
backups.where: In the server's backups folder, encrypted. Opening them needs the private key, which is kept off the server.
backups.offsite: Off-site copy: set up at installation on the Synology (destination still to choose).
